name: Web Services
description: Advanced distributed web services, RESTful architectural design, microservices communication, and cloud API integration.

instructorMessage.author: Dr. R. Sharma
instructorMessage.title: Message from Course Instructor
instructorMessage.content:
Dear Students,
Please read the following before forming your team:
• Team Size: 4-5 members
• Each member must be from the same batch.
• Use your Roll Number and Institute Email ID.
• Each student can be part of only one team.
• Topics: Choose from the list provided in 'Resources'.
• Submit team by 25 Oct 2026.
• Project proposal format is attached.

announcements.title: General Guidelines for Project Teams
announcements.content: Please ensure team members are finalized and topics are selected before the deadline. Project proposal templates must be submitted via the portal.

name: Design and Analysis of Algorithms
description: Algorithm design paradigms, graph theory algorithms, dynamic programming, NP-completeness, and performance analysis.

instructorMessage.author: Dr. P. Singh
instructorMessage.title: Algorithm Lab Project Guidelines
instructorMessage.content:
Dear Students,
For the Algorithm Analysis capstone project:
• Choose from dynamic programming, network flow, or approximation algorithms.
• Implement in C++ or Python with empirical benchmark plots.
• Group submissions must adhere to reproducible evaluation metrics.

announcements.title: Team Formation Deadline Extended
announcements.content: Team formation deadline for Algorithms capstone projects has been extended to 28 Oct 2026.

name: Database Systems
description: Database engine internals, query execution plans, transactions and isolation, indexing strategies, and distributed NoSQL storage.

instructorMessage.author: Dr. M. Verma
instructorMessage.title: Database System Design Project Specifications
instructorMessage.content:
Welcome to CS542.
Your semester project involves designing a fully normalized schema with replication, fault tolerance, and query indexing benchmarks.
Review the proposal format in the resources tab.

announcements.title: Submit Project Proposal Format
announcements.content: Use the approved institute proposal format attached in course resources before submitting your proposal.

name: Software Engineering
description: Software development lifecycle, Agile methodologies, CI/CD automated testing, clean code architecture, and capstone milestones.

instructorMessage.author: Dr. S. Nair
instructorMessage.title: Software Engineering Project Milestones
instructorMessage.content:
Welcome to CS544 Software Engineering.
All groups are required to use GitHub issues and pull requests to track development.
Milestone audits will occur bi-weekly with automated criteria evaluation.

announcements.title: Sprint Planning Session Schedule
announcements.content: Sprint 1 planning sessions will be scheduled during the lab hours next week. Review Agile guidelines.
